name: Bollinger Band Two MA and Zig-Zag
summary: This EA combines Bollinger Bands with two moving averages and a Zig-Zag indicator to identify mean reversion trading opportunities. It enters trades when price touches Bollinger Band extremes and confirms with moving average alignment and Zig-Zag swing detection. The system aims to capture price reversals back to the mean after overextension.
summary_zh: 该EA结合布林带、双均线和Zig-Zag指标来识别均值回归交易机会。当价格触及布林带极值时，结合均线排列和Zig-Zag摆动检测确认后入场。系统旨在捕捉价格过度延伸后向均值回归的行情。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是均值回归，利用布林带判断价格偏离程度作为主要入场依据。当价格触及上轨或下轨时，视为过度延伸信号，此时结合两条均线的排列方向确认趋势偏移。Zig-Zag指标用于识别价格摆动的高低点，过滤假突破和噪声波动，提高入场信号的可靠性。入场条件要求布林带边界触碰、均线方向确认和Zig-Zag转折三者共振，形成多重过滤机制。出场方面，价格回归中轨或均线交叉时平仓，同时设置止损控制单笔风险。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的方式，未发现复杂的资金管理模块。整体策略逻辑清晰，但依赖指标参数的精确调校，在不同市场周期下可能需要重新优化。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is mean reversion, using Bollinger Bands to gauge price deviation as the primary entry criterion. When price touches the upper or lower band, it is considered an overextension signal, confirmed by the alignment direction of two moving averages. The Zig-Zag indicator identifies swing highs and lows to filter out false breakouts and market noise, improving entry signal reliability. Entry conditions require confluence of Bollinger Band touch, moving average direction confirmation, and Zig-Zag reversal, forming a multi-layered filtering mechanism. Exit occurs when price reverts to the middle band or on moving average crossover, with stop-loss set to control per-trade risk. Position sizing uses fixed lots or balance-proportional methods without complex money management modules. Overall strategy logic is clear but depends on precise parameter tuning and may require re-optimization across different market cycles.

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Group take profit target amount (in currency)

pros: 多指标共振过滤，减少虚假信号，提高入场质量
均值回归策略在震荡市中表现良好，逻辑清晰易懂
Zig-Zag辅助识别关键转折点，有效过滤市场噪声
布林带动态适应市场波动率，自适应性强
pros_en: Multi-indicator confluence filtering reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Mean reversion strategy performs well in ranging markets with clear and understandable logic
Zig-Zag assists in identifying key turning points, effectively filtering market noise
Bollinger Bands dynamically adapt to market volatility with strong self-adaptability
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势市场中容易连续亏损
三个指标参数需要精确协调，过度优化风险较高
止损和止盈默认值为0，存在未设止损直接交易的风险
缺乏资金管理和仓位动态调整机制，风险控制有限
cons_en: Mean reversion strategy prone to consecutive losses in strong trending markets
Three indicator parameters require precise coordination with high over-optimization risk
Default stop-loss and take-profit values are zero, creating risk of trading without protection
Lacks money management and dynamic position adjustment mechanisms with limited risk control
improvements: 增加资金管理模块，支持基于风险比例的动态仓位计算
加入趋势过滤机制，在强趋势行情中暂停或反转交易逻辑
添加止损止盈的合理默认值和强制检查，防止无止损交易
improvements_en: Add a money management module supporting dynamic position sizing based on risk percentage
Implement trend filtering to pause or reverse trading logic during strong trending conditions
Add reasonable default values and mandatory checks for stop-loss and take-profit to prevent unprotected trading

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为零，可能无保护开仓
均值回归在趋势行情中逆势交易风险大
多指标参数优化可能导致曲线拟合
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, potentially opening unprotected positions
Mean reversion trades against the trend in trending markets with significant risk
Multi-indicator parameter optimization may lead to curve fitting
